title: Freezing and Processing Intestinal Biopsies for CD45+ Leukocyte Isolation
author: Oxford Hca
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6nvhde6
materials: Keep on ice until ready to freeze.
Homogenize on the gentleMACS using programme m_intestine_01.
Cells are now ready for downstream applications

steps.title: Collect biopsies in storage solution
steps.instruction: Place endoscopic biopsies into a 50 mL Falcon tube containing 5 mL cold MACS tissue storage solution, ensuring all biopsies are fully immersed.

steps.title: Prepare cryovials with Cs10
steps.instruction: Defrost a CoolCell LX to room temperature, label one cryovial per sample, and add 1000 µL of Cs10 to each cryovial.

steps.title: Transfer biopsies to cryovials and freeze
steps.instruction: Using a pastette (P1000) carefully remove the MACS storage solution from the Falcon tube without losing the biopsies, then transfer the biopsies with sterile forceps into the Cs10‑containing cryovial. Place cryovials into the CoolCell LX and move the CoolCell to a –80 °C freezer. Perform all actions in the hood and proceed to Stage 2 within 6 hours of collection.

steps.title: Store frozen samples appropriately
steps.instruction: On the next working day, remove the cryovials from the CoolCell LX and transfer them either to a liquid‑nitrogen box for long‑term storage or to a –80 °C box if the samples will be used within the next two months. Perform this step in the hood.

steps.title: Warm media and begin thawing
steps.instruction: Warm Complete Media and Digestion Media to 37 °C. Fill a gentleMACS C tube with 5 mL Digestion Media and a labelled 15 mL conical tube with 9 mL Complete Media. Thaw the frozen biopsy in a 37 °C water bath; when it is partially thawed, remove it from the water bath and transfer to the hood.

steps.title: Finish thawing and transfer to conical
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Complete Media (from the 15 mL conical) dropwise to finish thawing the biopsy, then use a pastette to transfer the biopsy and media into the same 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Filter and wash biopsy tissue
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm cell strainer onto a 50 mL conical tube, pour the biopsy suspension onto the strainer, and wash with 20 mL Complete Media. Using sterile forceps, transfer the biopsies into a gentleMACS C tube already containing 5 mL Digestion Media.

steps.title: Homogenize and incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tube on the gentleMACS using program “brain 01_02 (gentle)”. If tissue becomes caught in the rotor blade, use a pastette to push it back to the bottom. Then place the tube in a 37 °C shaking incubator set to 220 rpm for 1 hour.

steps.title: Strain and grind remaining tissue
steps.instruction: Strain the digested suspension through a 70 µm filter into a 50 mL Falcon tube. Grind any remaining tissue on the filter with a syringe plunger (pestle‑and‑mortar action) and wash cells from the blades, filter and tube with Complete Media using a pastette.

steps.title: First centrifugation and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 600 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C. Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 20 mL Complete Media. Centrifuge again at 600 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend in 35 % Percoll
steps.instruction: Resuspend the resulting pellet in 6 mL of 35 % Percoll, then transfer the suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Underlay 70 % Percoll gradient
steps.instruction: Using a glass Pasteur pipette, carefully underlay 3 mL of 70 % Percoll solution beneath the 35 % Percoll suspension.

steps.title: Gradient centrifugation and collect mononuclear layer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the gradient at 800 × g for 20 minutes at room temperature without brake (deceleration set to 7). Remove the interphase by first discarding a small amount of the top layer, then collect the layer located between the 35 % and 70 % Percoll and transfer it to a new 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Final wash and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Fill the tube to 15 mL with Complete Media, centrifuge at 600 g for 5 minutes (temperature not specified), discard the supernatant, and finally resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL Complete Media.
